posts.zh:
pty-runner 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。dsh 后台终端作业管理插件：在独立 PTY 会话中运行长时进程，写入普通文本与转义控制序列，分页读取环形缓冲输出，并支持优雅或强制终止作业。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-895937888e5fe47bf754.html
posts.en:
pty-runner is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Long-lived background terminal jobs for dsh: launch processes in a PTY, write input (including control sequences like Ctrl+C), page through ring-buffered output, and stop jobs gracefully or forcefully.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-895937888e5fe47bf754.html
